item.title: Appeals court rejects Trump's third-country deportation policy
item.description: A federal appeals court ruled Friday that U.S. immigration officials must offer detainees "a meaningful opportunity to contest" any deportation to countries where they have no ties.

item.title: Trump says he's struck deal for "permanent control over security" in Greenland
item.description: President Trump said he struck a deal to give the U.S. "permanent control over security" in Greenland following a push by the president to boost U.S. influence over the island — or take it over.

item.title: Neuroscientist explains how his team grew human brain tissue in mice and breaks down what they found
item.description: Neuroscientists at Stanford University successfully grew human brain tissue inside mice in the hopes of further enabling the development of treatments for brain disorders. Stanford Medicine professor of psychiatry and behavioral sciences Dr. Sergiu Pasca, who led the study, joins CBS News to break down the findings.

item.title: 2 ships attacked in Strait of Hormuz as Trump grapples with his next move
item.description: Following more attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, Trump said he'll make a "big decision" on whether to "annihilate" Iran's leadership.

item.title: Expert says AI companies need external safety audits: "We shouldn't have to take their word for it"
item.description: More than 100 artificial intelligence experts have signed a public letter to express the need for independent AI safety evaluators. Princeton computer science professor Arvind Narayanan, who signed the letter, joins CBS News to discuss.

item.title: Protesters gather outside Kennedy Center after Trump threatens demolition
item.description: Protesters gathered outside the Kennedy Center in Washington, D.C., on Friday evening after President Trump threatened to demolish the building. WUSA9 reporter Matt Gregory joins from the scene.

item.title: AI security experts say they used Claude to hack ChatGPT
item.description: Cybersecurity researchers said they were able to use Anthropic's Claude AI platfom to penetrate ChatGPT in "less than 72 hours."

item.title: Researchers report using Anthropic's Claude to hack OpenAI's ChatGPT
item.description: Researchers from the independent security platform Hacktron AI reported they used Anthropic's Claude tool to hack OpenAI's ChatGPT model. CBS News MoneyWatch reporter Megan Cerullo reports.

item.title: Trump says he's banning CNN, Politico and MS NOW from the White House
item.description: President Trump said Friday that he is banning CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House, the latest move to target media outlets over their reporting.

item.title: Nvidia CEO calls for AI to be developed "as fast as we can"
item.description: The CEO of the world's largest chipmaker told CBS News that tech companies should proceed with artificial intelligence development despite recent warnings from worried industry leaders that there may be a need to pull back.

item.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang says we should go "as fast as we can" with AI
item.description: Jensen Huang, the CEO of Nvidia, the world's largest chipmaker, told "Sunday Morning" that tech companies should push forward with the development of artificial intelligence despite recent warnings from worried industry leaders that there may be a need to pull back due to unease about the technology.

item.title: Trump says he's banning CNN, Politico and MS NOW from White House "effective immediately"
item.description: President Trump said Friday he's banning CNN, Politico and MS NOW from the White House in a move that could be challenged by courts. Weijia Jang reports.

item.title: Patrick Clancy: "I think I did the best I could"
item.description: Asked whether he feels like he failed in some way, Patrick Clancy told 60 Minutes he believes he did the best he could with the information he had at the time.

item.title: Patrick Clancy: "I think I did the best I could"
item.description: Asked whether he feels like he failed in some way, Patrick Clancy told 60 Minutes he believes he did the best he could with the information he had at the time. Watch more of the interview on 60 Minutes on Sunday.

item.title: What to watch this weekend with "Jay-Z in 8", "Stop! That! Train!" and more now streaming
item.description: SiriusXM Radio host Lamar Dawson joins CBS News to discuss the best streaming, TV and movie options available for this weekend.

item.title: Holdout juror in Lindsay Clancy trial says he "didn't have any doubts"
item.description: Michael Desronvil, the lone holdout juror in the high-profile Lindsay Clancy murder trial, said he "didn't have any doubts" during deliberations.

item.title: Steve Hartman reflects on parenting journey as his son leaves for college
item.description: Steve Hartman stays home this time around to let us into his parenting journey as his son George leaves the nest for college.

item.title: Princess Diana's brother makes "astonishing claims" against King Charles in new book
item.description: The late Princess Diana's brother, Charles Spencer, is making astonishing claims related to his sister's death and King Charles' behavior at the time in a new book. Holly Williams has more.

item.title: Holdout juror in Lindsay Clancy case says he "didn't have any doubts" about her guilt
item.description: The holdout juror in Lindsay Clancy's triple murder case has released a statement. Shanelle Kaul reports.

item.title: Most Americans think AI will harm humans, CBS News polling shows
item.description: Amid growing warnings about the pace of AI development, Americans told CBS News what they think of the tech. CBS News' Anthony Salvanto reports.

item.title: Details on Trump's announced White House ban against CNN, MS NOW and Politico
item.description: President Trump on Friday announced he was banning CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House. CBS News' Natalie Brand reports.

item.title: 9/18: CBS Evening News
item.description: Trump bans 3 media outlets from White House; Details of power bank fire on plane.

item.title: Pentagon releases UFO files with documents on secretive military program
item.description: The Pentagon on Friday released a new group of files about unidentified anomalous phenomena, or UAP or UFOs, including a batch of documents regarding a mysterious military program studying aerospace threats.

item.title: Will AI harm humans? Poll finds Americans want to slow development but not stop
item.description: Americans are optimistic about scientific advances in AI, but concerned that AI may take jobs.

item.title: DOJ says ban on selling handguns to young adults under 21 is unconstitutional
item.description: The Justice Department released a new legal opinion that concludes a federal law prohibiting firearms dealers from selling handguns to people between the ages of 18 and 20 is unconstitutional.

item.title: Use of AI backfires on an expert witness in court
item.description: The use of artificial intelligence in the courtroom is drawing fresh attention after an expert witness in a multimillion-dollar lawsuit used ChatGPT to help create his report.

item.title: Duncan Sheik, singer-songwriter of "Barely Breathing," dies at 56
item.description: Duncan Sheik died on Thursday night, his family said.

item.title: Facing 10 years in prison, ex-budget official flees U.S. by boat and plane
item.description: Kosta Diamantis is now a fugitive in Greece after fleeing the U.S. by boat and plane ahead of his sentencing for corruption, his lawyer and prosecutors said.

item.title: Patrick Clancy's wife: "I don't understand how the story's been so twisted"
item.description: Ross Douthat's interview with Patrick Clancy and his wife, Dr. Rachel Danis, airs Sunday on 60 Minutes.

item.title: Patrick Clancy says he still talks to his kids "all the time"
item.description: This Sunday on 60 Minutes, Patrick Clancy talks about his grief, his memories of his children, and the baseless conspiracy theories that flooded social media since his ex-wife's murder trial.
